meta.description: Illustrative EU default, not market data: a baseload PPA settled financially against your reference price series. Every value sits inside a cited public range (see notes); replace it with your own offer.
notes: not market data: a starting point to replace with your own offer or an organisation pack

range:price=71..85 EUR/MWh|European Commission DG ENER, Quarterly report on European electricity markets, vol. 18 (Q4 2025), p. 11: 2025 average baseload futures, three-year-ahead 71, year-ahead 85|https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/circabc-ewpp/d/d/workspace/SpacesStore/3fffc5f5-bdc8-45e2-bee3-1f872e9921d0/download|2026

range:baseload_mw=1..426 MW|1 MW = the delivery rate of one exchange baseload futures contract; 426 MW = the largest European PPA of February 2026 (Pexapark, reported by pv magazine); 20 MW is near the log-scale midpoint|https://www.pv-magazine.com/2026/03/17/pexapark-registers-30-european-ppas-for-2-2-gw-in-february/|2026

range:tenor_years=5..20 years|EIB Advisory, commercial PPA study: a cPPA is a long-term contract 'e.g. of 5-20 years'|https://advisory.eib.org/files/publications/attachments/developing-potential-financial-instruments-and-advisory-solutions-to-stimulate-more-investment-in-renewable-energy-generation-by-means-of-commercial-power-purchase-agreements.pdf|2023
reference_price: set your own day-ahead price series before settling
placeholders:seller,buyer,asset_ids hold a fill-in marker; the server refuses to save or settle the contract until each is replaced
changes_dispatch:false (settled after the solve; never shapes the dispatch)
